info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Surges-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Surge Information API provides comprehensive insights into surge pricing for rideshare services. It allows developers to retrieve real-time data about current surge areas and price multipliers, helping consumers make informed decisions while booking rides. Typical use cases include mobile applications and web platforms that aim to enhance user experience through transparency in ride costs. This API is essential for rideshare platforms, developers, and businesses looking to implement dynamic pricing features.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch available rides that are currently subject to surge pricing. It provides information on the surge conditions, including times and locations where the surge is applicable.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide necessary parameters for retrieving surge pricing information for rides. Ensure that all required fields are included for a valid request.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListRideshareRidesSurgesRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the surge operations in rides.

ListRideshareRidesSurgesResponse_204.title: Surge Operations Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the surge operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated from the surge operation.

state.description: The current state of the surge operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information related to the operation.

ListRideshareRidesSurgesResponse_204.description: This schema represents the response structure for the Surge Operations GET request.

Audit.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the surge operation.
